description: Redesign the Telemetry pages (Environments, API Keys, Remote Config) and Settings page with modern UI/UX patterns. Improve card layouts, table interactions, and form experiences for better usability.
steps: Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectEnvironmentsPage.tsx: (a) Improve the EnvironmentCard with a more visual color indicator (larger swatch or side accent bar). (b) Add an environment comparison view showing key metrics side by side. (c) Better action button placement with contextual visibility. (d) Add batch operations toolbar. (e) Improve the create dialog with real-time slug validation and color palette with preview.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectApiKeysPage.tsx: (a) Add a visual key health indicator showing usage patterns. (b) Improve the table with inline key prefix highlighting and better status indicators. (c) Redesign the key creation flow with better environment selector (visual cards instead of dropdown). (d) Add a key security score or health indicator based on age, usage, and rotation status. (e) Improve the usage sheet with better chart interactions and summary cards. (f) Add copy-to-clipboard with better feedback animation.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectSettingsPage.tsx: (a) Improve the SplitShell layout with better visual separation between sections. (b) Redesign toggle panels with better switch components and status indication. (c) Add unsaved changes indicator and auto-save feedback. (d) Improve the danger zone with clearer visual warnings and stepped confirmation. (e) Better form validation with real-time feedback.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/RemoteConfigPage.tsx: (a) Modernize the page to use the same shared primitives as other project pages (Panel, SectionHeading, etc. from @/shared/ui/pulse instead of the older @/shared/observe primitives it currently uses). (b) Improve the config version history with a timeline view. (c) Add JSON diff viewer for config changes.
Follow all rules.md constraints and use existing shared primitives.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectEnvironmentsPage has improved cards with visual color accents and better actions
ProjectApiKeysPage has improved table, key health indicators, and better creation flow
ProjectSettingsPage has better form UX with toggle improvements and danger zone redesign
RemoteConfigPage uses modern shared primitives consistent with other project pages
All changes use theme tokens only - no hardcoded colors
npm run build completes without new TypeScript errors
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it passes without new errors
